ways.time: 2 hr 30 min return from Whakapapa Village
evidence: After crossing Whakapapanui Stream at the top end of the Whakapapa Holiday Park, the track meanders through beech forest.
A little further up the hill the stream bed widens and forms a series of shallow terraces coated in creamy white deposits – the famous Silica Rapids.
The track is near Whakapapa Village on SH48. It starts 250 m above the Tongariro National Park Visitor Centre.

doubts: The main way is the Whakapapa Village section, which the page lists first. Its start is the village (T7); the text gives the trailhead as '250 m above the Tongariro National Park Visitor Centre' with no road end named, so no road-end ref is used. Its end is Silica Rapids. The DOC summary distance and time say 'return' from Whakapapa Village, so shape is out_and_back. The Bruce Road start is ref F2 (where the Silica Rapids Upper Track meets Bruce Road), which is a judgment because the text does not name the track; the Bruce Road section says to head back the way you came, so it is out_and_back. Time and distance for both ways are DOC's summary wording for each start, copied from the packet. The Whakapapanui Track turn-off has no entry in the names list, so ref is null.
